status: causal boundary proven; no repair attempted
decision: The exact weighted whole-shell Collapse operation is the first cause boundary for the rejected broad fascia and arch defects. A geometry-identical 30-degree smooth-normal control removes the invalid carried normals but retains the long-triangle faceting and fractured top. Collapsed topology is therefore the dominant cause; carried custom-normal interpolation amplifies some front-view contrast but is not sufficient to explain or repair the failure.

stageFindings.finding: The exact production nonlinear envelope fit changes the intended proportions but retains clean straight fascia and smooth arches in matched neutral clay.

Broad fascia and arches remain clean, but the current visible-shell flatten is independently destructive: 134483 vertices spanning -0.040258 to +0.041594 metres move to the datum, erasing raised top relief and chopping foliage into vertical slivers.
This is the first stage with the rejected broad triangular fascia/arch shading and fractured top geometry. It retains the broad silhouette while badly degrading interior surfaces.
Clearing custom split normals and calculating smooth normals with a 30-degree hard-edge threshold removes 40142 non-positive corner normals, but the broad defects remain clearly visible.

Not rerun. The first failing operation and its dominant geometry contribution were already isolated, and the archived rejected final candidate proves the later stage does not recover acceptable quality.

recommendedSingleComponentPilot.component: left front arch bay plus its adjacent straight fascia
method: Keep the fit-only dense visible surface unchanged and provide collision contact with a separate invisible 1.70 by 1.30 metre landing/collider mesh; do not flatten visible relief or foliage.
Extract only this semantic donor component. Author deliberate lower-resolution topology with straight fascia edges and radial arch loops instead of applying whole-shell Collapse.
If a normal transfer is needed, project only between this component pair so top, foliage, underside and neighboring-sheet hits are impossible by construction.

Require clean matched clay at front and three-quarter grazing views before making a normal or PBR proof. Let that clean component establish its required triangle count; do not begin with another arbitrary global budget.
recommendedSingleComponentPilot.stopCondition: If the isolated component cannot retain straight fascia and smooth arch curvature in clay, reject the method without extending it to the full platform.
